---
title: "Coverage map"
---

Click a province or territory to view the registry's coverage claims. A filled
jurisdiction has at least one claim; the fill does not show an exact model
footprint or imply a recommendation. Read subregional qualifiers, review status,
and notes in each popup.

```{=html}
<style>
.leaflet-container {
  background: #edf2ef;
}
</style>
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(readr)
library(htmltools)

canada <- st_read("data/geospatial/canada/ca.shp", quiet = TRUE)
coverage <- read_csv("derived/model_coverage_web.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

canada$jurisdiction_code <- substring(canada$id, 3L)
if (any(!grepl("^CA[A-Z]{2}$", canada$id)) || anyDuplicated(canada$jurisdiction_code)) {
  stop("Unexpected province or territory IDs in the Canada boundary file.")
}

shown <- function(value, fallback = "Not recorded") {
  if (length(value) == 0 || is.na(value) || !nzchar(trimws(value))) {
    fallback
  } else {
    as.character(value)
  }
}

popup_for <- function(jurisdiction_code, jurisdiction_name) {
  claims <- coverage[
    coverage$jurisdiction_code == jurisdiction_code,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  if (nrow(claims) == 0) {
    return(as.character(tags$div(
      tags$h4(jurisdiction_name),
      tags$p("No coverage claims recorded.")
    )))
  }

  claim_items <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(claims)), function(i) {
    claim <- claims[i, ]
    details <- c(
      paste0(
        "Basis: ",
        gsub(";", ", ", shown(claim$coverage_basis), fixed = TRUE)
      ),
      if (!is.na(claim$region_detail) && nzchar(claim$region_detail)) {
        paste0("Region: ", claim$region_detail)
      },
      paste0("Review status: ", shown(claim$verification_status))
    )

    tags$li(
      tags$strong(shown(claim$model_name)),
      tags$br(),
      paste(details, collapse = " | "),
      if (!is.na(claim$notes) && nzchar(claim$notes)) {
        tags$p(class = "mb-1 mt-1", claim$notes)
      }
    )
  })

  as.character(tags$div(
    tags$h4(jurisdiction_name),
    tags$p("Jurisdiction-level claims; qualifiers apply."),
    tags$ul(class = "mb-0", tagList(claim_items))
  ))
}

coverage_codes <- unique(coverage$jurisdiction_code)
canada$has_claims <- canada$jurisdiction_code %in% coverage_codes
canada$model_count <- vapply(canada$jurisdiction_code, function(code) {
  length(unique(coverage$model_id[coverage$jurisdiction_code == code]))
}, integer(1))
canada$fill_color <- ifelse(canada$has_claims, "#477b70", "#d8dedb")
canada$click_label <- paste0(
  canada$name,
  " - ",
  canada$model_count,
  ifelse(canada$model_count == 1, " model with claims", " models with claims")
)
popups <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(canada)), function(i) {
  popup_for(canada$jurisdiction_code[[i]], canada$name[[i]])
}, character(1))

leaflet(canada, options = leafletOptions(minZoom = 2, maxZoom = 7)) |>
  setView(lng = -96, lat = 59, zoom = 3) |>
  addPolygons(
    layerId = ~jurisdiction_code,
    label = ~click_label,
    popup = popups,
    popupOptions = popupOptions(maxWidth = 420, minWidth = 240),
    color = "#ffffff",
    weight = 1,
    opacity = 1,
    fillColor = ~fill_color,
    fillOpacity = 0.85,
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
      weight = 2,
      color = "#263d38",
      fillOpacity = 0.95,
      bringToFront = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomleft",
    colors = c("#477b70", "#d8dedb"),
    labels = c("Coverage claim recorded", "No claim recorded"),
    title = "Registry coverage",
    opacity = 0.85
  )
```
